chunks.text: Today, we will talk about the Dominican Republic.
It is a beautiful country in the Caribbean.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you want.
Where is the Dominican Republic?
The Dominican Republic is on an island.
The island is called Hispaniola.
This island is in the Caribbean Sea.
The Dominican Republic shares the island with Haiti.
The country is close to Cuba, Puerto Rico, and Jamaica.
It is warm, sunny, and full of beaches.
What is the capital city of the Dominican Republic?
The capital city is Santo Domingo.
It is a big and busy city.
Many people live there.
Santo Domingo is also very old.
It was the first city built by Europeans in the Americas.
It has old buildings, churches, and a special place called the Colonial Zone.
How many people live in the Dominican Republic?
About 11 million people live in the Dominican Republic.
Many people live in cities, but some live in the countryside.
The country has mountains, beaches, and villages.
What language do people speak in the Dominican Republic?
People speak Spanish.
Spanish is the official language.
It is the most common language in the Caribbean and Latin America.
Some people also speak English, especially in tourist areas.
In schools, children often learn English as a second language.
What is the weather like in the Dominican Republic?
The weather is hot and sunny all year.
It is a tropical country.
There are two main seasons, the dry season and the rainy season.
The dry season is from November to April.
The rainy season is from May to October.
But even in the rainy season, the sun often shines.
What does the Dominican Republic look like?
It has beautiful beaches, mountains, and forests.
The sand is white and the water is blue.
There are also rivers and green hills.
In the middle of the country, there is a big mountain called Pico Duarte.
It is the tallest mountain in the Caribbean.
The country is full of nature and color.
What animals live in the Dominican Republic?
There are many animals and birds.
You can see iguanas, parrots, flamingos, and butterflies.
In the sea, there are fish, dolphins, and sea turtles.
In winter, you can even see humpback whales in the ocean.
The country also has many national parks to protect nature.
What do people eat in the Dominican Republic?
The food is tasty and full of flavor.
People eat rice, beans, meat, and plantains.
One popular dish is called La Banderra.
It means the flag.
It has rice, red beans, and meat.
It is the most common lunch.
People also eat fried plantains, fish, and avocados.
For dessert, they eat sweet cakes, coconut candy, and fruit.
The country grows bananas, mangoes, and pineapples.
People also drink coffee, juice, and a sweet drink called Morir Sonyando.
It means to die dreaming.
What is life like in the Dominican Republic?
Life is joyful and full of music.
People are friendly and love to smile.
Family and friends are very important.
People often spend time together outside.
In the evening, people sit, talk, and listen to music.
Children play in the streets.
People enjoy dancing and relaxing.
The most popular music is Marangay and Bachata.
You can hear music everywhere.
In homes, in cars, and at parties.
Some fun facts about the Dominican Republic.
The flag has red, white, and blue colors.
The Dominican Republic was the first country in the New World with a cathedral, a university, and a road.
It is the most visited country in the Caribbean.
Baseball is the most popular sport.
Many famous baseball players come from the Dominican Republic.
The people are called Dominicans.
Now you know many things about the Dominican Republic.
You know where it is, what language people speak, and what the weather is like.
You know about the food, the animals, the music, and the culture.
Great work!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
